events-note: These are parsed events, not tactical judgements. Timecodes are absolute demo time, not video clips.
insight-no-weakness: No contextual weakness identified in the supplied analysis.
insight-trades: Keep a teammate in trading distance on entry attempts.
loss-context: Explore this player’s part in the result, including their positive contributions. Defeat alone does not establish blame.
no-events: No recorded events match this selection.
not-found: This player is not in this match.
strengths-unavailable: Personal strengths and weaknesses require contextual analysis. No conclusions are inferred from K/D/A.
unknown-context: The match outcome is unconfirmed. Available actions are shown without a result-based rating.
win-context: Explore this player’s contribution to the win, alongside the actions that could be improved.
